label: MiMo
notes: Usage Export is XLSX (not CSV): Token Plan token_plan_usage_*.xlsx (single sheet) or Pay-as-you-go usage_data_*.xlsx (Model usage detail + Plugin sheet).
Wide shape: Date | Model | Total Tokens | Input Hit Tokens | Input Miss Tokens | Output Tokens | Total audio duration | Request Count.
input=Input Miss Tokens, cacheRead=Input Hit Tokens, output=Output Tokens, requests=Request Count; Date is a UTC day.
Amounts/currency and the Plugin sheet are ignored (P1). Parsed in-extension (shared/xlsx.js).
